name: Kaskantyú (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kaskantyú (a shield of blue and white with a cross, a saint, a bunch of grapes and a green base) below the name KASKANTYÚ in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
